_comment: Consistency lock for Higgsfield generation. Reuse these IDs so every generated video keeps the same characters, background and voices. Filled in when we start generating (no credits spent yet).

tropzilla.notes: Purple godzilla in a dark suit, yellow spinal plates, left podium. Embed prompt_token in generate_image/video prompts to reuse.

legend.notes: Purple octopus in a pink/red suit, tentacles, right podium. Embed prompt_token in generate_image/video prompts to reuse.

background.notes: Neon sunset beach debate stage: two podiums, palm trees, crowd with glowsticks, 'THE GREAT DEBATE' logo top-left, 15s timer top-right, CROWD METER bottom. For continuity prefer image-to-video from the previous clip's last frame (see start_frames).

start_frames._comment: Per-clip continuity anchor: image the generated video must start from (usually the previous video's last frame). Storyboard: 'use the first image as the exact starting point'.
